verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs say it automatically creates a new daily note every day for journaling (reflect-docs-26, reflect-docs-36). Several capture paths land in that note: voice transcriptions, web bookmarks and highlights, the deep-link append command, calendar events and the API daily-notes endpoint (reflect-docs-34, reflect-docs-29, reflect-docs-46, reflect-docs-13, reflect-supp-openpm-spec). Nothing in the pack shows daily notes being pre-filled from a template, which is an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: template pre-fill for daily notes, explicit evidence that the daily note is the default view on app open, independent or hands-on corroboration.
